unit.unitinstructions:
Consent to Participate

You are being invited to participate in a research study. The purpose of this research is to evaluate how individual factors, such as prior knowledge, anxiety level, and need for cognition, influence the optimal difficulty level in adaptive training for Chinese character components. The study will involve experiencing three different difficulty levels of training and a posttest to determine the optimal difficulty level considering individual factors. You have been invited to participate because you are an experienced Amazon Turk worker. You will be one of 240 subjects taking part in this research.

If you agree to participate, you will be asked to complete the following procedures:

       1. The experiment consists of two parts. The first part involves training sessions on Chinese character components, which will take approximately 1 hour. The second part will take place 2 days later and will include a posttest (approximately 15-25 minutes) with the same items from the training sessions, as well as some survey questions.

      2. In the first part, there will be a total of three 15-minute training sessions with different difficulty levels for Chinese character components. During each session, you will be presented with fill-in-the-blank items and asked to type the corresponding English meaning. Please do your best to answer all the items based on your current knowledge. You will have 10 seconds to begin typing your answer (the timer resets while you are typing). Press ENTER after each response or if you are unable to make a guess. If you provide an incorrect response for an item, you will review the correct answer for 6 seconds. If your response is correct, the feedback will be displayed for 1 second. After each training session, you will be asked a few questions regarding your thoughts on the training.

      3. The second part will take place 2 days later. You will complete a posttest that consists of fill-in-the-blank items, similar to the training sessions, along with survey questions about demographic information, anxiety levels, and the need for cognition.

Participating in this study is completely voluntary and if you decide to participate now, you may change your mind and stop at any point. You may choose not to answer any survey questions or do the training.

As a participant in this research study, you may gain knowledge about Chinese character components. The findings of this research may provide recommendations for implementing adaptive training with optimal difficulty in real-world scenarios.

There are no foreseeable risks involved in participating in this study other than those encountered in day-to-day life.

Upon completion of the research study, you will receive compensation. After completing the first part, you will be paid $12. Additionally, there is also a bonus of $0.05 for each correct answer during the three training sessions. Most participants can expect a bonus of $10 or $15 with moderate effort (e.g., achieving 200 or 300 correct answers). It is important to note that the bonus, along with an additional $5 for participating in the second part, will be paid when you return and complete the second part of the study.

All efforts, within the limits allowed by law, will be made to keep the personal information (your Amazon Turk Worker ID) in your research record private, but total privacy cannot be promised. We will deidentify your data (remove your ID) after the experiment before storing it on our computers long-term. Because of privacy and confidentiality limitations associated with using MTurk IDs, we cannot guarantee complete anonymity. Worker IDs will only be used to distribute payment and will not be stored with survey responses. MTurk Worker IDs will not be shared with anyone. Further identifying information we gather (e.g. demographic information or IP addresses) will never be attached to your responses.

If you have questions about the research you may contact Meng Cao at 901-281-7348 or via email at mcao@memphis.edu and, or Philip Pavlik at 901-678-2326 or via email at ppavlik@memphis.edu. For questions regarding the research subjects' rights, the Chair of the Institutional Review Board for the Protection of Human Subjects should be contacted at 901.678.2705 or via email at irb@memphis.edu.

ELECTRONIC CONSENT

Please select your choice below. You may print a copy of this consent document for your records. Clicking on the Continue button indicates that you:

  • Have read the above information
  • Voluntarily agree to participate
  • Are 18 years of age or older

In the first 15-minute training session, you will engage in adaptive practice of Chinese character components. This session will be conducted at our highest difficulty level, aiming for approximately 70% correct responses. Please make an effort to learn the items and provide accurate responses. We are examining whether this level of difficulty provides the optimal challenge for your learning.

During each trial, a Chinese character component will be presented, and you are required to type the corresponding English meaning within 10 seconds. Press ENTER after each response or if you are unable to make a guess.

If you provide an incorrect response for the item, you will have a 6-second opportunity to review the answer. In the case of a correct response, the feedback will only be displayed for 1 second.

Please answer four survey questions regarding the training session you just completed.

Read each statement carefully and choose the option that best reflects your agreement.

In the second 15-minute training session, you will engage in adaptive practice of Chinese character components. This session will be conducted at our lowest difficulty level, aiming for approximately 90% correct responses. Please make an effort to learn the items and provide accurate responses. We are examining whether this level of difficulty provides the optimal challenge for your learning.

During each trial, a Chinese character component will be presented, and you are required to type the corresponding English meaning within 10 seconds. Press ENTER after each response or if you are unable to make a guess.

If you provide an incorrect response for the item, you will have a 6-second opportunity to review the answer. In the case of a correct response, the feedback will only be displayed for 1 second.

Please answer four survey questions regarding the training session you just completed.

Read each statement carefully and choose the option that best reflects your agreement.

In the third 15-minute training session, you will engage in adaptive practice of Chinese character components. This session will be conducted at our medium difficulty level, aiming for approximately 80% correct responses. Please make an effort to learn the items and provide accurate responses. We are examining whether this level of difficulty provides the optimal challenge for your learning.

During each trial, a Chinese character component will be presented, and you are required to type the corresponding English meaning within 10 seconds. Press ENTER after each response or if you are unable to make a guess.

If you provide an incorrect response for the item, you will have a 6-second opportunity to review the answer. In the case of a correct response, the feedback will only be displayed for 1 second.

Please answer four survey questions regarding the training session you just completed.

Read each statement carefully and choose the option that best reflects your agreement.

Based on your overall experience from the three training sessions, please answer the following three survey questions regarding the learning methods you used.

Carefully read each statement and select the option that aligns best with your agreement.

Dear Amazon Turk Worker,
 Thank you for completing Part 1 of the 'Individual Differences in Optimal Learning' experiment, which offered a payment of $12.00. We kindly request your participation in Part 2 of the experiment. Part 2 requires less effort compared to Part 1, and we will compensate you with a payment of $5.00 upon completion. In addition, we will provide an extra bonus based on the number of correct answers you provided in Part 1 ($0.05 per correct answer, for example, $10 for 200 correct answers) when you return to complete Part 2. Please ensure that you complete Part 2 within 48 hours of receiving this email.
 To ensure a smooth process, please enter your Turk ID accurately, as any typos may prevent us from identifying you as a Part 2 participant and hinder the payment of your bonus. You will know that you have continued correctly when you see the message 'Thank you for continuing with the experiment. You have now reached the posttest.'.
  To proceed, please follow this link to Part 2: https://mofacts.optimallearning.org/experiment/indradicals
 We appreciate your participation in this study.
Best regards,
Meng and Phil
unit.unitinstructions:
Congratulations on completing Part 1 of the experiment!

To ensure that your assignment is approved and you receive the $12 payment, please enter the code 'AXDTYUY' into the Amazon Mechanical Turk website for this HIT and submit your response now. We will review your completion and approve your assignment accordingly.

Please note that you have a countdown of 2 days for part 2 of the study. After this timeframe, you will receive a private Turk message (delivered to your email inbox normally) containing instructions for Part 2. Completing Part 2 will earn you $5, in addition to an extra bonus based on the number of correct answers you provided in Part 1.

Thank you for your participation, and keep an eye on your email inbox for further instructions on Part 2. If you do not receive a followup email 48 hours from now, feel free to contact us.

Thank you for continuing with the experiment. You have now reached the posttest.

In the posttest, you will be presented with the 117 Chinese character components. Some of these you may not have seen in session 1 since not all items are introduced for all participants. Your task is to type the corresponding English meaning for each component. The timing and feedback will follow the same format as Part 1.

Survey questions

Please answer the following 19 survey questions. Your responses will help us better understand a few individual differences. The survey consists of the following sections:

1. Demographic Information : Answer three questions about your basic demographic details.

2. Learning Experience : Share your thoughts on your learning experience with the experiment material by answering two questions.

3. Test Anxiety : Evaluate your test anxiety level based on your past testing experiences. Consider all testing experiences when responding to the ten questions in this section.

4. Need for Cognition: Measure your inclination and enjoyment of thinking with four questions.

To complete the survey, read through each statement and select one option that best describes you.
Your answers have been submitted. Thank you for participating in this challenging study of learning and assessment. Your account will be credited with the bonus after we check your results.
